messages:
marie_support: PolarisWorks procurement replied — they will not accept a final invoice without a formal PO and their VAT/Tax ID on file. They want our company tax id and their PO template before we can bill. invoice id: INV-2024-0456. Any guidance? :thinking:
sam_sales: Thanks for flagging. Do we have a signed SOW for this account? Who is the procurement contact there?
procurement_julia: They clearly stated 'no PO, no invoice' in their procurement docs. I have the procurement contact (laura@polarisworks.com). I can reach out but we should avoid issuing the final invoice until PO arrives. Can we send a pro forma instead?
billing-bot: System: INV-2024-0456 status changed to "on_hold" (reason: awaiting customer PO).
marie_support: Created pro forma in billing system and emailed PolarisWorks with details and our tax id (EIN 12-3456789). Pro-forma link: https://billing.redwood.internal/proforma/INV-2024-0456. Asked them to return signed PO and VAT number for EU tax handling.
ops_ryan: For now put account on proforma-only billing to avoid accidental final invoicing. Also suggest adding a CRM flag "awaiting PO" with follow-up cadence. If procurement drags, we can offer a short-term credit hold.
sam_sales: I'll escalate to the AE (dave@redwood.com) to request the PO template and confirm whether an emailed PO is acceptable for their AP team. If they need a specific PO format, ask them to attach it to the reply.
procurement_julia: I'll copy legal if they push for contract amendments. Also asked PolarisWorks to provide their VAT/Tax ID and billing address format (they're EU-based). If they give a VAT ID, we may need to zero-rate the invoice depending on cross-border rules.
marie_support: Noted — ticket TKT-9876 updated with the hold and pro-forma. I'll follow up with PolarisWorks in 48 hours if no response. Please add any notes in the ticket thread. :thumbsup:
sam_sales: Good plan. If PolarisWorks supplies a PO referencing INV-2024-0456 we can convert pro-forma to final invoice and release for payment. Keep me looped.
procurement_julia: Update: contacted laura@polarisworks.com — she confirmed they use an internal PO number schema and will send their PO template. ETA 2 business days.
marie_support: Thanks — keeping billing on hold until we receive the PO. Will close the loop here once we have the PO and VAT ID.
